canonical_name: Sperner's theorem for antichains in a finite Boolean lattice (exact claim variant open)
literal_source_claim_en: The maximum size of an antichain in a power set.
source_attribution: Emanuel Sperner; 1928 (catalog metadata, confirmed by the inspected primary paper)
statement_blocker: The inspected primary theorem states the middle-binomial upper bound, attainability by middle layers, and the complete even/odd equality classification, while the catalog says only 'maximum size'. target_decision: retain the source-defined finite Boolean-lattice theorem family at provisional H1/M3/R4 and freeze no canonical proposition until the statement variant is independently reviewed

canonical_formal_target.candidate_expression: {alpha : Type u} [Fintype alpha] {A : Finset (Finset alpha)} -> IsAntichain (fun x y => x ⊆ y) (A : Set (Finset alpha)) -> A.card ≤ Nat.choose (Fintype.card alpha) (Fintype.card alpha / 2)
